resources.string: Experience seamless, instant control for your Dianora Smart TV right from your smartphone.

No built-in Infrared (IR) emitter was detected on this device.

To send commands to your Dianora TV, please connect an external IR blaster dongle (via 3.5mm audio jack or USB-C adapter) and tap 'Check Again'.

You can also explore the remote interface in simulation mode.
Your device\'s internal IR blaster is active and ready to transmit 38 kHz NEC-encoded signals to your Dianora TV.
